title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
statement:
Implement a Trie (prefix tree) data structure that supports the following operations:

1. Insert a word into the trie
2. Search for an exact word in the trie
3. Check if any word in the trie starts with a given prefix

All inputs consist of lowercase English letters.
constraints: word and prefix consist of lowercase English letters only
At most 3 * 10^4 calls will be made to insert, search, and startsWith in total

visibleExamples.explanation: Create a Trie, insert 'apple', search for exact matches and prefixes, then insert 'app' and search again.

jsonFriendlyReason: Trie is a design problem where the class itself is the solution; it requires a custom adapter to handle class instantiation and method calls.
